title: 第0005章 土中生绿芽人心起疯痧第0006章 土中生绿芽人心起疯痧
lines: 耙耧山的日头，活了这辈子从没受过这样的委屈。
百年大旱，烤得山秃地裂、万物死寂，它本该稳稳悬在天上，压得整座药王沟喘不过气，让所有草木俯首、凡人认命。可偏偏就在方才，雪见站在药神坛上开口拦人的一瞬，漫天滚烫的日光忽然虚了一角，烈烈热风僵在半空，连晒在人身上那层灼人的烫，都轻飘飘褪了三分。
最邪门的，是地。
干裂得能吞进手掌、硬得能硌碎鞋底的黄土焦层，前一秒还是死透的灰黄色，像一块晒焦的死人皮。下一秒，无数道狰狞的地缝深处，星星点点的嫩绿，怯生生、顽生生地钻了出来。
不是野草，不是庄稼苗。
是细碎到极致、薄如蝉翼的草芽，细细一根青茎，顶着两瓣嫩黄芽叶，从死寂的黄土缝里顶破生死，疯了似的往外窜。
风一拂，万千细芽轻轻摇晃。
没有风声，没有叶响，整片山野静得诡异。
可雪见听得清清楚楚。
密密麻麻、软软糯糯的呜咽声，从脚下土地里漫上来，缠在耳边、绕在心头。那是新生草木的啼鸣，不是悲苦，是怯生生的活，是绝境里硬生生挣出来的生机。
草木活了。
药王沟，就乱了。
晒谷场上的几百号村民，瞬间成了一群被定住的木偶。
前一刻还吵吵嚷嚷、凶神恶煞，逼着拿白芷献祭求雨，人人眼底都是利己的贪婪、从众的狂热；这一刻，所有人张大嘴巴、瞪圆眼珠，脖子僵得笔直，死死盯着脚下破土而出的绿芽，连呼吸都忘了。
荒诞这东西，在耙耧山从来不用刻意找。
它就埋在黄土底下、人心深处，旱灾压着、苦日子捂着，看着安安稳稳，只要一丝裂缝，就能疯长出满坑满谷的荒唐。
“活了……土真的发芽了。”
一个半大老头颤巍巍开口，声音抖得像秋风里的枯草，打破了满场死寂。他蹲下身，粗糙皲裂的大手小心翼翼贴在地面，指尖触到那细嫩的草芽，冰凉、鲜活，带着一股久违的草木潮气。
这潮气淡得可怜，却足够推翻药王沟百年来的常理。
百日无雨，寸草不生的焦土，凭啥发芽？
凭人一张嘴？凭村支书一句拦阻？
没人说得通，可所有人都眼睁睁看着，由不得不信。
人群彻底乱了套，先前的虔诚、凶狠、狂热，瞬间碎得七零八落，换上来的是铺天盖地的惊恐与盲从。乡下人一辈子活天命、信鬼神、怕异象，寻常风雨阴晴都能扯出吉凶祸福，更何况这逆天的土中生绿。
“不是药神显灵！”有人慌慌张张后退，声音发飘，“方才咱们要活人献祭，药神是恼了，又回头赏了生机？”
“狗屁！”另一个壮汉粗声反驳，眼神飘忽不定，“你们没看见？是雪见支书站上去之后，地才动的、草才生的！”
这话一出，所有人的目光齐刷刷聚焦在高台之上。
落在雪见清瘦单薄的身影上，敬畏里裹着忌惮，惊奇里藏着恐慌。
方才人人都盼着神明救世。
此刻人人都觉得，神明未必显灵，是凡人成了异数。
雪见立在药神坛中央，蓝衣被微凉山风掀得轻轻晃动，耳畔草木啼鸣不绝，温柔又细碎，缠得她心头五味杂陈。她低头看着台下乱作一团的村民，看着这群在绝境里反复变脸、比野草还善变的乡人，心底只剩一场说不出的荒诞悲凉。
方才她拦下降祭，不是为了显本事、逞威风。
只是不忍。
不忍十六岁的白芷，清清白白一辈子，温顺纯良如白芷草木，最后沦为一群贪生怕死之徒的活命祭品，成了黄土里无声无息的冤魂。
可她这一抬手、一开口、护住一条人命的功夫，竟换来了整片枯山返青，天地异象丛生。
她终于彻底懂了。
自从吃下雪见草的那一刻，她就不再是从前那个平平无奇、守着山村过日子的村支书了。
她拴着这片山的草木生死，拴着这条沟的人心浮沉。
草木随她心念生，人心随她异变疯。
content_en:
The sun on the mountain has never been so wronged in this life.
A hundred years of severe drought have left the mountains bare and cracked, and all things dead. It should have been hanging steadily in the sky, weighing down the entire Yaowang Valley, making all vegetation bow their heads and mortals accept their fate. But just now, when Xue Jian stood on the Altar of the Medicine God and opened her mouth to stop people, the scorching sunlight in the sky suddenly disappeared, and the fierce hot wind froze in the air. Even the scorching heat on the body faded by three points.
The most evil thing is the earth.
The scorched layer of loess, so dry that it could be swallowed into the palm of your hand, and so hard that it could crush the soles of your shoes, was still a dead gray-yellow color a second ago, like a piece of dead skin that was burned by the sun. The next second, from the depths of countless ferocious cracks in the ground, dots of green emerged timidly and mischievously.
Not weeds, not crop seedlings.
It is an extremely finely broken grass bud, as thin as a cicada's wings, a thin green stem, with two tender yellow leaves on top, breaking through the cracks of life and death in the dead loess, and rushing out like crazy.
When the wind blows, thousands of tiny buds sway gently.
There was no sound of wind, no rustling of leaves, and the whole mountain was eerily quiet.
Ke Xuejian heard clearly.
Dense, soft and waxy whimpers rose up from the ground beneath their feet, lingering in their ears and in their hearts. That is the cry of new vegetation. It is not sorrow, it is a timid life, and it is the vitality that is forcibly earned in a desperate situation.
The vegetation comes alive.
Yaowanggou was in chaos.
The hundreds of villagers on the grain drying field instantly became a group of immobilized puppets.
A moment ago, they were noisy and vicious, and they were forced to sacrifice Angelica dahurica to pray for rain. Everyone's eyes were full of self-interested greed and herd fanaticism; at this moment, everyone had their mouths wide open, their eyes rounded, their necks stiff, staring at the green buds breaking out of the ground under their feet, and they forgot to even breathe.
Absurdity is something that you never have to look for in Kulu Mountain.
It is buried under the loess, deep in the hearts of people, suppressed by drought and covered by hard times. It looks safe and stable, but as long as there is a crack, it can grow wildly and fill the valley with pits and absurdity.
"It's alive...the soil is really sprouting."
A half-grown old man spoke tremblingly, his voice trembling like withered grass in the autumn wind, breaking the dead silence in the place. He squatted down and placed his rough, chapped hands carefully on the ground. His fingertips touched the tender grass buds, which were cold and fresh, carrying a long-lost moisture from the vegetation.
This moisture is pitifully light, but it is enough to overturn the centuries-old common sense of Yaowanggou.
There has been no rain for a hundred days, and the scorched earth where no grass can grow, how can it sprout?
Based on a person's mouth? Stop it with just a word from the village party secretary?
No one could make sense, but everyone watched helplessly and couldn't help but believe it.
The crowd was completely in chaos. The previous piety, ferocity, and fanaticism were instantly shattered into pieces, replaced by overwhelming fear and blind obedience. Countryside people live by destiny, believe in ghosts and gods, and fear visions. Ordinary wind, rain, and weather can bring good or bad luck, not to mention the greenery growing in the earth that defies the heavens.
"It's not the God of Medicine showing up!" Someone backed away in a panic, his voice wavering, "Just now we wanted to sacrifice a human being, but the God of Medicine was annoyed and turned around to reward him with life?"
"Bullshit!" Another strong man retorted harshly, his eyes wandering, "Didn't you see? It was only after Party Secretary Xuejian stood up that the ground moved and the grass grew!"
As soon as these words came out, everyone's eyes were focused on the high platform.
Falling on Xue Jian's thin figure, fear was wrapped in awe, and panic was hidden in surprise.
Just now everyone was looking forward to God's salvation.
At this moment, everyone feels that gods may not appear, but mortals are the exception.
Xue Jian stood in the center of the Medicine God Altar, her blue clothes swaying gently in the cool mountain breeze, and the grass and trees were singing incessantly in her ears, gentle and delicate, which made her feel mixed. She looked down at the chaotic villagers in the audience, looking at these villagers who repeatedly changed their faces in desperate situations and were more fickle than weeds, and there was only an unspeakable absurdity and sadness in her heart.
She stopped the sacrifice just now, not to show her ability or show off her power.
I just can't bear it.
The sixteen-year-old Bai Zhi, who had been innocent all her life, as gentle and pure as the Bai Zhi grass and trees, was finally reduced to a living sacrifice by a group of people who were greedy for life and fearful of death, and became a silent and innocent ghost in the loess.
But the moment she raised her hand, opened her mouth, and protected a human life, she actually caused the entire dry mountain to turn green, and the world to be filled with strange phenomena.
She finally understood.
From the moment she ate the snow grass, she was no longer the ordinary village party secretary who lived in a mountain village.
She is tied to the life and death of the grass and trees in this mountain, and the ups and downs of the people's hearts in this ditch.
Plants and trees grow according to her thoughts, and people's hearts become crazy according to her changes.
title_en: Chapter 0005: Green sprouts grow in the soil, and people start to get sick. Chapter 0006: Green sprouts grow in the soil, and people start to get sick.
